summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus for Toyota Auto Receivables 2026-C Owner Trust, an asset-backed securitization of auto loans. Toyota Auto Finance Receivables LLC, as depositor, is offering $1.9 billion in notes rated across five tranches: Class A-1 ($440M at 3.913%), A-2a ($528M at 4.29%), A-2b ($131M at SOFR+0.31%), A-3 ($659M at 4.51%), A-4 ($94.5M at 4.61%), and a non-offered Class B ($47.5M at 0%). Credit enhancement includes reserve account, overcollateralization, and subordination. This is a routine shelf takedown of asset-backed notes, not a special situation. The filing is a standard ABS issuance with no change-of-control, M&A, or activist element.
